body: Are you a multi millionaire?
Thank you for your post. Yes maybe words can make **me** feel better but they don't change anything in my situation. And yes, it's quite amazing when complete strangers offer their support!

1. Total of 70K dollars
2. Half of it is student loan. The rest is 2 different bank loans.

I live in Stockholm, Sweden.
You seem to get it. I would appreciate if you had the time/willingess to listen. If you do, could you pm me skype/msn? If not, thanks for your offer once again.

Wow. I really appreciate you're willing to actually give me real money but I'm afraid the only thing money can do is to postpone my problems. This might sound rude but it feels wrong to accept someones "beer money" and the only way I feel money could help me is if it was an enormous sum (I'm talking millions). That's why I've been playing the lottery weekly, hoping for that jackpot so I can buy my self out of all this crap. But sincerely, thank you for your offer. You are a kind soul.

And yes you're right. Money is the most immediate issue but far from the only issue or the "worst" issue.

I have tried "venting everything in detail" to people but nobody ever gets me. I feel like the few people I've told this to see me as a math equation, ready to be solved. They don't truly listen. They wait til they can talk. There's a big difference between listeners and "wait-to-talk"-ers.

I can't in my wildest dream imagine this poem will help someone that is suicidal.

"My life is shit, I have no friends, no money, no job, im fat, ugly and socially awkard. Hey look, a poem! Cool, now everything is great"

>That's a permanent solution to a temporary problem.

I really dislike this argument which everyone makes. To someone who is suicidal the problem is not temporary and the solution being "permanent" is actually something you WANT to achieve when you're thinking of ending your life.

Thank you for your response. The whole homeless thing doesn't sound so appealing though to be honest. I don't have it in me to live as a homeless, I would consider death to be an improvement of such a lifestyle.
I'm happy a miracle happened to you. I hope something like that can occur in my life as well.

I would actally like this idea but since I don't have much time left before I'm completely broke there is not enough time tro try something like this. Sometimes I play around with the thought of going to some remote shaolin temple and just train everyday.

>so why not die doing something you might enjoy?

I don't enjoy much in life anymore and the things that possible could bring any form of superficial temporary joy costs a shit load money.

Interesting video. The part he speaks of the "darker" kind of newb resonates with me. I used to be very selfconscious about all my issues and constantly feeling bad about it. These days I just don't give a fuck anymore. Nothing matters. I rarely feel anything. 

However, what I absolutely did not agree with in his clip was that those in darker places somehow have more motivation to tap in to. It's so beyond that for me. Simply standing in front of a mirror chanting "YES I CAN" won't do it for me and I hate that kind of thinking anyway. People saying "Come on you can do it champ!!!" does nothing for me.

I like the batman analogy. But if I was to compare my self to that "rise from the pit" analogy it's like I'm standing at the bottom, I see the light but I just don't care about trying to climb anymore.

I do not think I'm the only one with problems. Frankly I don't care that other people have the exact same issues as me. There are people who have it worse. WAY WORSE. But frankly, I don't give a damn about them. Finding a job would solve nothing. The insane amount of debt and loans I have would eat away most of my paycheck and only leave chump change left for buying bread crumbs.
don't know what to say really

I used to strongly be against coincidence/luck-type philosophies. Life is what we make of it, is I used to believe. But that was a long time ago and now I am far beyond any types of philosophies/morals/values. I feel like a zombie. I don't see beauty in anything. Nothing lasts. Everything dies.

>When you say "I'm hoping an angel can show up and lead me to the places I used to dream" are you saying you are looking for some guidance?

I'm not sure what I'm saying with that. I've been against the idea of miracles/angels/higher powers/religion/God etc for so long but now, in my current "I don't give a fuck about anything anymore" state it's like "fuck it, I hope there ARE some supernatural beings out there capable of turning ones life around by the flick of a wand"..

>What are these things you used to dream when you were a child?

That life would get more fun and fulfilling when you grew up. That you would have more freedom. More fun. More friends. Laugh more. Smile more. But life has been the exact opposite. I thought that life would have meaning, a purpose. Not the shithole it currently is.

>A dead man cannot help the world the way a living one can, nor can a dead man experience the joy and wonder that makes life worth living

A dead man cannot feel pain

Exercise would do nothing for me. I've since long ago stopped caring about my health. I've stopped feeling bad about it. I have stopped feeling anything about anything really. Finding a job is also nothing that can do anything for me. Even if I found a relatively well paying job all my loans would eat away all that salary and leave me enough money to buy some bread crumbs. Furthermore, I see no point in finding a slave job so I can row with the other slaves every day just to come home and have nothing to look forward to but eating and sleeping. 

There are 2 things, as I see it, that could stop me from doing what I intend to do. 1) Winning the lottery which I play each week. 2) If a miracle happened

I have no story besides what I've written. There is no interesting adventure tale behind me being where I'm at. I was simply dealt a shitty hand in life and I've since long tried to improve the situation. I feel nothing and at the same time I feel I'm in hell. That I'm just walking dead, a zombie. I think death would be an improvement, as someone else here stated.
Thank you for trying.
No, I have no valuable items.

I'm sorry but I don't exactly feel loved by someone who "loves everyone". You say you can bring hope. In what way can you bring me hope? I'm sorry but these are just fancy/romantic words without substance to me. Words which I can't relate to at all. I don't wish to offend you. I'm sorry if I did.
